name: Google Ads
description: Google Ads API v23 — generate Keyword Planner ideas and historical metrics, manage campaigns, ad groups, ads, keywords, and budgets, and run performance reports via GAQL

credential_fields.name: developer_token
credential_fields.label: Developer token
credential_fields.description: Required Google Ads API developer token from the API Center of your manager account.

credential_fields.name: manager_customer_id
credential_fields.label: Manager customer ID
credential_fields.description: Optional 10-digit manager account ID, without hyphens. Required only when accessing a client account through a manager account.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List all Google Ads customer accounts accessible to the authenticated user. Returns customer IDs and descriptive names. Use this first to find the customer_id needed for all other tools.

tools.name: generate_keyword_ideas
tools.description: Generate Google Keyword Planner ideas from keywords, a page URL, both, or an entire site. Returns keyword text plus historical metrics such as average monthly searches, monthly search volumes, competition, competition index, and top-of-page bid ranges. Set exactly one of keywordSeed, urlSeed, keywordAndUrlSeed, or siteSeed. Use resource names such as languageConstants/1000 and geoTargetConstants/2840.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID without hyphens.

language.description: Optional language resource name, for example languageConstants/1000 for English.

geoTargetConstants.description: Up to 10 geo target resource names, for example geoTargetConstants/2840 for the United States.

keywordAnnotation.description: Optional annotations to include, such as KEYWORD_CONCEPT.

historicalMetricsOptions.description: Optional date range and CPC controls for the returned historical metrics.

keywordSeed.description: Use this seed for one or more product/service phrases.

urlSeed.description: Use this seed to generate ideas from one page URL.

keywordAndUrlSeed.description: Use this seed to combine product/service phrases with one page URL.

siteSeed.description: Use this seed to generate ideas from an entire site.

tools.name: generate_keyword_historical_metrics
tools.description: Get Keyword Planner historical metrics for known keywords: average monthly searches over the past 12 months, per-month search volume, competition level/index, and low/high top-of-page bid ranges. This is market-volume data, not performance data from an existing campaign. Near-identical keywords may be deduplicated by Google.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID without hyphens.

language.description: Optional language resource name, for example languageConstants/1000.

geoTargetConstants.description: Up to 10 geo target resource names.

historicalMetricsOptions.description: Set includeAverageCpc=true to include average CPC and optionally select a historical year/month range.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Run any valid GAQL query against this customer, including conversion_action, asset, campaign_asset, customer_asset, ad_group_asset, call_view and click_view. Returns Google's complete native response with no campaign-row normalization or field whitelist. Use get_field/search_fields to discover fields and compatibility. Query conversion-action metadata separately from campaign/action metrics and join using the conversion-action resource name. Google calls expose campaign/ad-group attribution, not GCLID or ad ID; click_view exposes GCLID and ad resource names but is not an individual-conversion ledger. click_view requires exactly one segments.date within the last 90 days; GCLIDs are unavailable for App Campaigns for Installs/Pre-registration. Google forwarding-number call reporting must be enabled for call details. Application-owned IDs, phone mappings, qualification rules and match status must be joined by the caller.

Examples (replace IDs/dates for your customer):
- Daily campaign costs and conversions: SELECT segments.date, campaign.id, campaign.name, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.conversions, metrics.conversions_value, metrics.all_conversions, metrics.all_conversions_value FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
- Conversion-action definitions: SELECT conversion_action.resource_name, conversion_action.id, conversion_action.name, conversion_action.type, conversion_action.category, conversion_action.origin, conversion_action.status, conversion_action.primary_for_goal, conversion_action.phone_call_duration_seconds FROM conversion_action
- Campaign/day conversion breakdown: SELECT segments.date, campaign.id, segments.conversion_action, segments.conversion_action_name, segments.conversion_action_category, metrics.conversions, metrics.conversions_value, metrics.all_conversions, metrics.all_conversions_value FROM campaign WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
- Campaign phone assets: SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign_asset.asset, campaign_asset.field_type, campaign_asset.status, asset.id, asset.call_asset.country_code, asset.call_asset.phone_number FROM campaign_asset WHERE campaign_asset.field_type = 'CALL'
- Google call details: SELECT campaign.id, ad_group.id, call_view.resource_name, call_view.call_status, call_view.call_duration_seconds, call_view.start_call_date_time, call_view.end_call_date_time, call_view.call_tracking_display_location, call_view.type FROM call_view WHERE call_view.start_call_date_time >= '2026-09-01 00:00:00' AND call_view.start_call_date_time < '2026-09-02 00:00:00'
- Click identifiers for one day: SELECT segments.date, campaign.id, ad_group.id, click_view.resource_name, click_view.gclid, click_view.ad_group_ad FROM click_view WHERE segments.date = '2026-09-01'

Keep daily spend/click totals separate from conversion-action breakdowns to avoid repeating or double-counting totals. metrics.conversions_value/all_conversions_value are currency amounts; metrics.cost_micros is micros. Counts may be fractional and conversion metrics use attribution rules rather than representing individual events. Campaign phone assets alone are not exhaustive: also query customer_asset and ad_group_asset for inherited/account/ad-group call assets. qualified is not a call_view status (statuses are RECEIVED/MISSED/UNKNOWN/UNSPECIFIED); apply your own documented qualification rule or analyze the configured conversion action.

customer_id.description: Google Ads customer ID without hyphens. Select the customer using list_accounts.

query.description: Unrestricted GAQL SELECT query; choose the FROM resource and compatible fields using get_field/search_fields. Use segments.conversion_action to break down campaign conversion metrics; retrieve conversion_action definitions in a separate query. Phone numbers use asset.call_asset.phone_number. call_view reports call details; click_view reports GCLIDs for a single date within 90 days. See the search tool examples.

page_token.description: Legacy alias for pageToken. Use either spelling, never both; sent to Google as pageToken.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the previous response; reuse the identical GAQL query. Do not also provide page_token.

validateOnly.description: Validate the GAQL query without executing it. Use this to check resource/field compatibility.

searchSettings.description: Native Google Ads SearchSettings. pageSize is unsupported for GoogleAds:search.

returnSummaryRow.description: Include a separate summary row, default false.

returnTotalResultsCount.description: Return total matching rows ignoring LIMIT, default false.

tools.name: campaign_mutate
ad_group_mutate
ad_mutate
keyword_mutate
budget_mutate
asset_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, or remove reusable Google Ads assets: images, text assets, YouTube video assets, lead form assets, call assets, sitelinks, callouts, structured snippets, and other asset types supported by the Google Ads API. Use campaign_asset_mutate, customer_asset_mutate, asset_group_asset_mutate, or ad assets on ads to attach created assets where needed.

tools.name: campaign_asset_mutate
tools.description: Attach, update, or remove assets at campaign scope. Use for campaign-level sitelinks, callouts, lead forms, images, and other asset links. Operations target campaignAsset resources.

tools.name: customer_asset_mutate
tools.description: Attach, update, or remove assets at customer/account scope. Use for account-level assets such as sitelinks, callouts, lead forms, calls, and other supported asset links. Operations target customerAsset resources.

tools.name: ad_group_criterion_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, or remove ad group criteria beyond keywords: audiences, placements, topics, demographics, listing groups, and other ad-group targeting criteria. keyword_mutate is a convenience alias for keyword criteria on this same endpoint.

operations.description: Array of ad group criterion operations (create/update/remove)

tools.name: campaign_criterion_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, or remove campaign-level criteria: locations, languages, negative keywords, audiences, and other campaign targeting or exclusions.

tools.name: user_list_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, or remove remarketing/customer match user lists. Use this for audience resources that can be targeted from campaigns or ad groups.

tools.name: data_manager_user_lists_list
tools.description: List Google Ads Customer Match user lists through the Google Data Manager API.

login_account.description: Optional manager resource name, for example accountTypes/GOOGLE_ADS/accounts/1234567890.

tools.name: data_manager_user_list_get
tools.description: Get one Google Ads Customer Match user list through the Google Data Manager API.

tools.name: data_manager_user_list_create
tools.description: Create a Google Ads Customer Match user list through the Google Data Manager API.

tools.name: data_manager_user_list_update
tools.description: Update a Google Ads Customer Match user list through the Google Data Manager API.

tools.name: data_manager_user_list_delete
tools.description: Delete a Google Ads Customer Match user list through the Google Data Manager API.

tools.name: data_manager_audience_members_ingest
tools.description: Add normalized and hashed identifiers to a Google Ads Customer Match user list.

tools.name: data_manager_audience_members_remove
tools.description: Remove normalized and hashed identifiers from a Google Ads Customer Match user list.

tools.name: data_manager_request_status_get
tools.description: Retrieve ingestion diagnostics and completion status for a Google Data Manager request.

tools.name: conversion_action_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, or remove conversion actions for tracking leads, purchases, signups, page views, and other conversion goals.

tools.name: asset_group_mutate
tools.description: Create, update, or remove Performance Max asset groups. Use together with asset_group_asset_mutate to attach images, logos, headlines, descriptions, videos, and other assets to a Performance Max campaign.

tools.name: asset_group_asset_mutate
tools.description: Attach, update, or remove assets inside Performance Max asset groups. Operations target assetGroupAsset resources.

operations.description: Array of asset group asset operations (create/update/remove)

tools.name: bulk_mutate

mutateOperations.description: Array of typed operations (campaignBudgetOperation, campaignOperation, adGroupOperation, adGroupAdOperation, adGroupCriterionOperation, etc.)

partialFailure.description: If true, allows partial success. If false (default), all operations fail if any one fails.

tools.name: get_field
tools.description: Retrieve Google Ads v23 field or resource metadata: category, dataType, selectable/filterable/sortable, selectableWith, attributeResources, metrics, segments and enumValues where supplied. Use this to discover supported attribution fields and combinations before constructing a GAQL query. Examples: campaign, segments.conversion_action, conversion_action.type, asset.call_asset.phone_number, call_view.call_status, click_view.gclid. This returns metadata, not customer data.

field_name.description: GAQL resource or field name without the googleAdsFields/ prefix.

tools.name: search_fields
tools.description: Discover Google Ads v23 fields and query compatibility using GoogleAdsFieldService. This metadata query has NO FROM clause. Example: SELECT name, category, data_type, selectable, filterable, sortable, selectable_with WHERE name LIKE 'call_view.%'. Another example: SELECT name, category, selectable_with WHERE name IN ('campaign', 'segments.conversion_action', 'metrics.conversions', 'asset.call_asset.phone_number'). Returns all native metadata and pagination; no customer_id is needed.

query.description: Metadata GAQL query: SELECT field metadata followed by optional WHERE/ORDER BY/LIMIT; omit FROM.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken returned by the previous metadata search.

pageSize.description: Requested metadata page size; provider may cap it. Unlike GoogleAds:search, GoogleAdsFields:search supports pageSize.
